title: Amram the Dyer
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: [Gittin 52b](https://www.sefaria.org/Gittin.52b.5) relates that he was a guardian of orphans and came before Rav Nachman. His name is not otherwise known among the sages, according to Hyman.[^1][^2]

notes.text: The linked Gittin names Amram as the guardian. Its wording has the relatives come before Rav Nachman. Hyman’s shortened account gives Amram as the one who came. [Heilprin](https://www.girsology.com/seder-hadorot.html?entry=2903&lang=en) also cites Gittin 52b and is unsure whether Amram was a scholar.
צבעא is the lexical occupational epithet the Dyer; it does not add a personal rabbinic title or certify an authority identity.
